title: PennState vs UWMadison: tuition, size, location
summary: Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona (PennState) versus University of Wisconsin-Madison (UWMadison). Also searched as UWMadison vs PennState. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona and University of Wisconsin-Madison are both public institutions but differ significantly in size and location. PennState vs UWMadison shows that Penn State Altoona has an undergraduate enrollment of 2,367 students, whereas University of Wisconsin-Madison enrolls 36,902 undergraduates. Additionally, Penn State Altoona is located in Altoona, while University of Wisconsin-Madison is situated in Madison. Tuition costs for in-state students also vary, with Penn State Altoona charging $15,972 compared to University of Wisconsin-Madison's $11,603.

sections.heading: Cost
paragraphs: When comparing Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona and University of Wisconsin-Madison, tuition costs reveal notable differences. For in-state students, PennState vs UWMadison shows that Penn State Altoona charges $15,972 annually, while University of Wisconsin-Madison's tuition is lower at $11,603. Out-of-state tuition at Penn State Altoona is $26,958, significantly less than University of Wisconsin-Madison's $42,103. Regarding student debt, the median debt for completers at Penn State Altoona is $25,000, whereas University of Wisconsin-Madison reports a median debt of $20,484. These figures highlight the varying financial commitments required by students attending these two public universities.

paragraphs: Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona and University of Wisconsin-Madison both offer traditional on-campus learning experiences but differ in scale and setting. In contrast, University of Wisconsin-Madison, situated in Madison, Wisconsin, enrolls 36,902 undergraduates, reflecting a much larger campus community. These differences in size and location contribute to distinct campus atmospheres and learning environments at each institution.

sections.heading: Pick PennState if
paragraphs: Pick Pennsylvania State University-Penn State Altoona if you prefer a public university with a very high admission rate, as PennState vs UWMadison shows an admission rate of approximately 98.06%. sections.heading: Pick UWMadison if
